newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Mozambique to privatise national airline - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mozambique to privatise national airline - paper.

text.p: The Mozambican government has launched a tender for the privatisation of the national airline Linhas Aereas de Mocambique (LAM), the official daily Noticias said on Wednesday.
The paper said the government's intention was to sell off 51 percent of the company to private interests, but that it intends to keep the airline in Mozambican hands.

If foreigners wished to bid for LAM they had to do so in partnership with Mozambican companies. The tender documents state that foreign capital could not exceed 30 percent of any consortium that presents bids, the paper said.
But foreign participation should also not be lower than 20 percent, since the government hoped that foreign civil aviation companies would play a key role in managing the company.
